don-fax.name: Don Fax
don-fax.designNote: Short, square and heavy: a floor-standing office copier-fax combo that walks on four stubby caster legs. From above, the silhouette is a wide rectangle with the scanner lid tipped forward like a fedora brim, and a long curl of thermal paper always feeds out of his mouth slot like a cigar he never lights. Materials: chipped cream enamel casing with ink-black pinstripes painted down the sides, a cracked control panel on his chest with one vermilion 'TONER' warning light that never goes out, and two rubber paper-feed rollers for hands. Two small teal status-LED eyes under the lid. Palette: cream, violet-black ink, vermilion, and teal for the eyes only.

nurse.name: Juno Stitch
nurse.designNote: Slim, upright and quick: a robot built on a rolling hospital IV-pole chassis, with a sewing-machine head on a long neck and the needle bar for a pointed nose. One hand is a fine needle-driver clamp and the other is a stubby surgical-tape dispenser. From above: a narrow oval body ringed by hanging IV bags, with a single trailing tube. Materials: cream enamel with ink stitch-lines painted along every seam like quilted patchwork, a roll of tape worn as a bracelet, and a vermilion bandage stripe across one shoulder (a stripe, not a cross). Two teal eyes of slightly mismatched sizes. Palette: cream, violet-black ink, vermilion, and teal for the eyes only.

gunsmith.name: Brass Halloran
gunsmith.designNote: Huge, barrel-chested and low: a robot built around a cast-iron bench vise for a jaw and a drill-press column for a spine, with forearms like pipe wrenches. From above: a broad trapezoid with an anvil-flat head and a bandolier of spent shell casings over one shoulder. Materials: ink-black cast iron with vermilion scorch marks, a cream canvas welder's apron burned at the hem, a jeweller's loupe riveted over one teal eye (the other teal eye is bare), and a pencil stub tucked into a bolt-hole ear. scientist.name: Dr. Ingrid Kilohm
scientist.designNote: Very tall and thin, folded like a desk lamp: a robot built from a valve-radio oscilloscope. Her face is a round CRT screen where two teal waveform lines act as eyes and twitch when she thinks. From above: a long narrow body with a dust cover draped like a lab coat and two bent rabbit-ear antennas. Materials: cream bakelite casing, ink-black dials and knobs down her front like buttons, a clipboard on a chain, a stethoscope made from an old probe lead, and a hand-painted vermilion 'DO NOT OPEN' warning on her back panel. Palette: cream, violet-black ink, vermilion, and teal for the CRT eyes only.

quartermaster-mertz.name: Quartermaster Duane Mertz
quartermaster-mertz.designNote: Boss. A tall, wide human army quartermaster, a desk soldier gone to seed who signed for every crate and treats the weapon stock like his own pension. From above: a flat-topped garrison cap, broad padded shoulders, a boxy battery backpack with a thick coiled cable running to the Robo-tazer, and a clipboard clipped to his belt. Materials: an ink-black dress uniform with too many cream ribbon bars, thick vermilion rubber lineman's gloves and insulated boots (he is grounded and proud of it), ear defenders around his neck and a fat moustache.
